name: Franco Python Template
summary: Example App from the brainlife.io Python App template: reslices a T1-weighted image to a chosen voxel size with DIPY.
description: Template/example App. main.py loads the T1 with nibabel, reslices it to the voxel size given in outres with dipy.align.reslice, and saves out_dir/t1.nii.gz. Use it as a starting point for writing Apps, not for analysis.

parameters.description: Output voxel size in mm as three space-separated integers (x y z); main.py splits on spaces and converts each value to int.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al., Pestilli F. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
